spots.note: Free public Space Gallery at Lot Fourteen with hands-on exhibits; named by Wikivoyage, SATC and Experience Adelaide (three counted sources). Permanent museum-style exhibit, 30-60 min.

spots.bio: The Parliament of South Australia, with free public tours on non-sitting days.
spots.name: Parliament House
spots.note: The Parliament of South Australia (managing agency) runs free public tours, no booking, twice daily on non-sitting days, covering the 1850s chamber, House of Assembly and Legislative Council; open to the public inside. Case against: civic building, tour-only; no SATC listing found.

spots.bio: Pedestrian shopping mall in the city centre, with the Mall's Balls sculpture.

spots.bio: Free Japanese garden in the south Park Lands, with a teahouse and stepping stones.
spots.name: Adelaide Himeji Garden
spots.note: Experience Adelaide features the free Japanese garden (rock-and-sand and lake gardens, teahouse, stepping stones) in the south Park Lands, open daily. Case against: small, ~30 min.

spots.bio: Formal garden in the south Park Lands with a serpentine canal and statues.
spots.name: Veale Gardens
spots.note: Experience Adelaide lists Veale Gardens: formal serpentine canal, statues and the adjacent Adelaide-Qingdao Rose Garden, with guided walks on SATC. Permanent, free. Case against: ordinary Park Lands garden.

spots.bio: Conservation reserve protecting an intact dune system on the Adelaide coast, with a walk.
spots.name: Tennyson Dunes
spots.note: Wikivoyage and the parks agency name it as the state's most accessible intact dune system, with a walk to do (rule 1, 2).

spots.bio: Beach suburb north of Semaphore with an 1882 jetty, kiosk, playground and foreshore walk.
spots.name: Largs Bay
spots.note: City of Port Adelaide Enfield's visitor pages list the Largs Bay foreshore: 1882 jetty, kiosk, playground, walking paths, Largs Pier Hotel. A named beach and historic jetty. Council page was blocked to scripts (403); details from search. Against: no SATC listing.

spots.bio: Southern beach suburb with a jetty, esplanade and the Brighton Jetty Sculptures.
spots.name: Brighton
spots.note: SATC's Adelaide beaches guide features Brighton: jetty, esplanade, Brighton Jetty Sculptures; Wikivoyage names the beach via the Seaford line. A second-tier beach.

spots.bio: Family beach near the airport on Adelaide's western coast, with sand and calm water.
